report.summary: Patient P-D001 (Raymond Ellis, 58, ESRD on dialysis, type 2 diabetes) screens positive for food worry ("sometimes_true") and reports eating mostly corner-store food on dialysis days because the grocery is a bus ride away and he is fatigued after treatment. His home census tract (17031260300) is low-income with high food-insecurity prevalence (47.7% adults) and 50.3% food stamp use, and 27.7% of households have no vehicle. Four food options were found; eligibility checked for medically tailored meals (form submitted, pending response). The community fridge and pantries appear to have no income/ID barriers (No ID required at Northwest Side pantry; Cook County residency for Saturday pantry).

options.name: Madison Street Community Fridge
options.how_to_access: Open daily 8 AM–8 PM; take what you need, no ID required.

options.name: Northwest Side Food Pantry
options.how_to_access: Open Mon/Wed/Fri 12–3 PM; no ID required; fresh produce on Wednesdays.

options.name: Medically tailored meals referral (dialysis/diabetes-appropriate)
options.how_to_access: Eligibility form submitted (patient has ESRD on dialysis and diabetic CKD); program will respond within one business day.

fields.diagnoses: End stage renal disease (N18.6) on dialysis; Type 2 diabetes with diabetic chronic kidney disease (E11.22); Hypertensive CKD (I12.0)
